queries: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT "archstat" AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT "arcref") AS tally FROM "scanqc" GROUP BY "archstat"), status_shares AS (SELECT status, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT status, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT status, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: A project is counted once per archival status; a project with QC records in multiple statuses is counted in each of those groups.

alternatives.interpretation: Tally QC records for projects under each archival status, including repeated records for the same project.

assumptions.assumption: A project is counted once per archival status. If it has QC records with different statuses, it is counted in each applicable status.

alternatives.interpretation: Count QC records associated with projects, so repeated records for the same project and status each contribute to the tally.
